author: Thomas_Shoe
body:
Hi all!   My name is Thomas_Shoe, and I will be back on the Avicus Network, its been about 6 months ago.

I heard about the "omega" update and the server seems to be in really good shape!

I don't really recognize many familiar names, probably because of the name change update.

So, I'll be active on forums and in-game once again, hope to see you online
